note: What a server sends to say whether a client draws the world without colour while its champion is down. The header names a champion: that of the player it is sent to.

bits.name: enabled
bits.note: Set where the world is drawn without colour. Clear, it does not stop a client drawing the world without colour while its champion is down.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: Unused; a server writes zero.

bits.name: enabled
bits.note: Set where the world is drawn without colour while the client's own champion is down; clear, the world is drawn in colour then. It is set as the champion is created. Sent for any other champion, it changes nothing shown.
